scientific_integrity: Proof includes conditioning, explicit lattice local-limit argument, and bounded-degree locality; finite checker corroborates enumerative identities only.
scientific_limitations: Fixed cap and uniform isomorphism-class sampling; no claim for labelled, ordered or monadic-second-order models. A stronger historical restricted-part result might imply the coordinate law; priority is not independently established.
title: The full first-order probability spectrum for bounded-multiplicity unlabelled permutations
